newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader Begum Khaleda Zia may meet leaders of other opposition parties this month to seek support for her planned agitation against the government.
The government, in view of the European Union ban on Bangladeshi shrimp, will prepare a fresh list of processing plants by October able to maintain EU health standard.
Home (interior) Minister of Indian state of Tripura has said Tripura would not allow use of its territory by any extremist organisation operating against Bangladesh.

Former Vice Chancellor of the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology Mohammad Shajahan has cautioned the Indo-Bangla treaty on Ganges water sharing might not work due to shortage in availability of water at the border point.
The government will erect a mausoleum on the grave of the independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, assassinated in a military coup in 1975.
About 83 percent of the respondents in a recent opinion poll said corruption was a major obstacle to development in Bangladesh.
AES Transpower Pvt Ltd, a U.S. based company, has emerged lowest in the bidding for setting up a 300 megawatt combined cycle power station at Haripur near Dhaka.
A Bangladesh team left Dhaka for Singapore on Tuesday to pursue CFTC, a Singapore-based Feeder vessel Trade Committee, to withdraw congestion surcharge at the Chittagong Port.
